evidence: Astro 7.3.3 imports CachePolicy from this package only in astro/dist/assets/build/remote.js for remote-image response caching. A fresh clinic runtime image contains only Nginx and generated dist files; it has no Node.js executable or http-cache-semantics files.
rationale: The vulnerable code runs only in Astro's static build path and is absent from the deployed runtime image. The GitHub-reviewed advisory reports no patched version: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp.
